scripts.cap:init: npx cap init "SUP'ONE AI" com.supptic.suponeai --web-dir dist
scripts.cap:sync: npm run build && npx cap sync android
scripts.android:build: npm run cap:sync && cd android && .\gradlew.bat assembleDebug
scripts.android:build:win: powershell -NoProfile -Command "$j = Get-ChildItem 'C:\Program Files\Microsoft\jdk-21*' -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Select-Object -First 1; if (-not $j) { $j = Get-ChildItem 'C:\Program Files\Microsoft\jdk-17*' | Select-Object -First 1 }; if ($j) { $env:JAVA_HOME = $j.FullName }; npm run android:build"
